provenance_note: The Palmer colony-count data and concentration summaries have been analyzed previously. This is not outcome-blind preregistration of the dataset; it prospectively freezes a new durable-extinction endpoint, risk-set construction, statistic, null and decision rule before that endpoint is computed.

source.unit: reported colony_code within island and breeding season

question: During the Palmer Adelie decline, do small breeding groups disappear non-randomly before larger groups within the same island-year risk set?

biological_hypothesis.name: small-group vulnerability
biological_hypothesis.prediction: A colony code that is small immediately before a transition has a higher probability of durable local disappearance than larger contemporaneous colony codes on the same island.
biological_hypothesis.mechanistic_scope: A positive result is consistent with social facilitation and/or size-dependent predation vulnerability, but colony counts alone do not identify either mechanism causally.

endpoint.entry: A colony_code enters the risk set after its first strictly positive breeding-pair count.
endpoint.primary_event: The first census year with count == 0 after a positive census, provided that the colony remains at zero in every later observed annual census and at least two later annual censuses are available.
endpoint.event_time: Assign the event to the first zero year; predictors are measured in the immediately preceding positive year.
endpoint.censoring: Rows without sufficient future follow-up to establish the primary event are right-censored and cannot contribute an extinction event.
endpoint.reappearance: Any later positive count means the earlier zero is not a durable-extinction event.

risk_set.definition: For each island and transition year t-1 -> t, include colony codes with a strictly positive count at t-1 and an observed count at t.
risk_set.relative_size_report: colony count at t-1 divided by island total at t-1; descriptive because within an island-year it is a monotone rescaling of absolute colony size.

primary_statistic.risk_set_standardization: Within each island-year risk set, z-standardize log1p prior colony size using all at-risk colonies when SD > 0.
primary_statistic.contrast: Mean standardized prior size among durable-extinction events minus mean standardized prior size among non-events, pooling event-bearing risk sets with equal weight per risk set.
primary_statistic.interpretation: Negative values mean colonies that disappear were already smaller than contemporaneous colonies exposed to the same island-year context.

null_and_inference.null: Conditional on each island-year risk set and its observed number of durable extinctions, event identities are exchangeable among at-risk colony codes.
null_and_inference.permutation: Permute event labels independently within each event-bearing island-year risk set while preserving the observed number of events in that risk set.
null_and_inference.p_value: one-sided lower-tail Monte Carlo p with +1 correction

effect_size_outputs: number of durable-extinction events and event-bearing risk sets
risk-set matched event/non-event size ratio on the original count scale where defined
event rates by pooled prior-size quartile as a descriptive display

secondary_hazard_model.role: effect-size summary, not the primary inferential gate
secondary_hazard_model.model: discrete-time logistic regression of event on within-risk-set standardized log1p prior colony size, with island indicators and centered calendar year
secondary_hazard_model.inference: report coefficient and odds ratio; primary permutation test governs the confirmatory decision

sensitivities.two_zero_rule: Repeat with durable extinction requiring the first zero plus at least one later annual zero and no later positive count.
sensitivities.exclude_litchfield: Repeat the primary risk-set permutation after excluding Litchfield Island.
sensitivities.leave_one_island_out: Report the primary contrast after removing each island in turn.
sensitivities.count_threshold: Repeat after requiring prior count >= 2 pairs to reduce dependence on one-pair observations.

decision_rule.support: Primary contrast < 0 and one-sided permutation p <= 0.05.
decision_rule.stronger_mechanistic_pattern: Support plus negative contrast in at least 4 of 5 leave-one-island-out analyses and the two-zero sensitivity.
decision_rule.failure: Otherwise do not claim systematic small-group extinction.

interpretation_boundaries: Do not call colony_code a mapped physical patch unless an external code-to-polygon crosswalk is established.
Do not infer skua predation, social facilitation, snow exposure or habitat quality directly from this analysis.
Do not describe the test as fully outcome-blind; earlier Palmer analyses used the same count dataset.
Do not replace the primary durable-extinction rule or risk-set permutation with a more favorable post hoc definition.
A positive result identifies size-selective disappearance within shared island-year conditions, not the cause of the regional Adelie decline.
